content: Dokopa Kamongome Mosese lamaiyuo, Kanda, nambame emba kiŋinya lenge kambu dokona Anatu yale inginyi pyambwaronopa embena yangone Erone dokome embena poropeta dopale ingyapala pii lamaiyakara.
Nambame emba dopa pipi dopa pipi lao pii langilyu dusipa peparae pao Erone lamaipi. Lamairinyi dokopa baame pao kiŋi doko lamaiyuo, Isaraele wambu dupwa yuu doko yaki nyuo pena lena lara.
Dopa piramopape nambame kiŋi doko mona pokanyi pyambwaro. Pyambwapala nambame yulu wambumi pii nange lapo pirunupape baame embena pii soo nyii nara.
Dokopa nambame yuu Isipi range dupwa randa andake mairunupa nambana Isaraele wambu dupwa Isipi yaki nyuo lanyuo paro.
Dopa pyuo nambame nakama kanda soo pyaronopa Isaraele wambu dupwa yuu Isipi yaki nyuo lanyuo eparami. Dokopa Isipi range dupwame namba Anatu lao soo nyerami, leya.
Mosese Eronepa Anatu leyamuli pyuo piyambi.
Nakambame kiŋi kando pii lamaiyambinyi yuu gii dokopa Mosese baa ee kana akalisa mange lama karo (80) dee Erone ee kana akalisa mange lama ipisu rema (83) nembo kareya.
Eronena Pangali Isa Doko
Kamongome Mosese Eronepa kando lamaiyuo,

Peraome nakamba kando yulu andake wambumi pii nange mende nakamba keta porai renge palamo lao lasaka pyuo pipwape leya kande dokopa Erone banya pangali isa doko Peraona lenge kambu sera dokona pyao pyambunya lao lamaipi. Dopa piramo dokopa pangali doko pao kau ingyara, leya.

Lapeyamo dokopa Mosese Eronepa Perao kareyamo dokona peyambi. Papala Anatu leyamuli pyuo Eroneme banya pangali isa doko Peraomoo banya yulu pingi akali mupwa dusipa kareyaminyi dokona pyao pyambuyamo dokopa doko pao kau ingiya.
Doko kandapala dokopa Peraome banya soo gisingi akalipi pipu lenge akalipi lapo epena leya. Leyamo dokopa pipu lenge dupwa epapala nakamana porai dokome yulu dopaleko isingi piyami.
Nakamana pangali isa dupwa pyao pyambuyaminyi dokopa pao kauko ingiya. Dopa piyaminyipape Eronena pangali isa dokome doloma peparae nao goe leya.
Dopa piyaminyipape Anatumi kiŋi baame warombo see nara lao leyamuli pyuo Mosesepa Eronepa pii leyambinyi doko see nao banya mona kana pokapala kareya.
Randa Andake Lapo Yuu IsipiKeta Epeya
Ranjama Doko
Dokopa Kamongome Mosese lamaiyuo, Perao baa ama porayapala wambu dupwa kingi raka lao pena laa nalyamo.
Dokona yangama nakamba ipwa Naele pona dokona paraŋa dokona papala Perao kando nyerambi. Nakambame pangali isa kau ingiyamo doko minyuo papala ipwa kee kama dokona baa isaro karalapape.

Dokopa embame kiŋi doko lamaiyuo lao, Ipuru wambu dupwa yuu muiyane dokona papala nambana kingi lakando kararami lao Kamongo nakamana Anatu dokome embame nakama pena lape lao puu lapyasa epo leto. Dopa lapunupape wamba langiyunu simbi simbi piinyi dopaleko ingyuo epapu pilini.

Epapu emba kiŋi doko aki mende nambame piru doko kandapala embame namba apiŋi lao soo nyera lao Kamongome letamo. Kanda. Kusape dakeme ipwa ketae dokona pyaronopa ipwa doko alowa pyuo ranjama ingyara.
Dopa piramo dokopa kau oma dupwa kumarami dokopa ipwa doko ama ai wakasa pyarasa Isipi range wambu dupwa kapa pyuo kamuo nalana saka narami lare, leya.

Kamongome Mosese lamaiyuo lao, Embame Erone lamaiyuo banya pangali isa doko nyepala yuu Isipi dokona ipwa epo pengepe ipwa epo pena lao suu nyingipi ipwa pete singipi dupwa peparaena ketae palyuo minyaro karena lamairi. Dopa piramo dokopa ipwa peparae ranjama ingyuo dee isa lukuluku pisinya ipwa singi dupwanape dee kana wasisinya ipwa petenge dupwanape opetaeko ranjama ingyuo yuu peparaene ranjama soo pira.

Mosese Eronepa Anatumi leyamuli pyuo piyambi. Kiŋi Peraomoo banya yulu akali mupwa dupwa pipya kareyaminyi lenge kambu dokona Eroneme banya pangali isa doko minyalyapala ipwa doko piya. Piyamo dokopa ipwa dupwa alowa pipala ranjama ingiya.
Dopa piyamopa kau oma ipwana singi dupwa kumuyami. Dokopa ipwa dupwa ama ai wakasa piyasa Isipi range dupwa kapa ipwa naa nayami. Yuu Isipi dokona ranjama dokome mee ree ingiya.
Dokopa Isipi range akali pipu lenge dupwame epo yulu mendaki dopaleko piyami. Piyaminyipa Perao baa poraiyuo kaeya. Kamongome dopa pira leyamuli pyuo kiŋi dokome Mosese Eronepa pii see naya.
Doo piyamo dupwana mendepe soo nyuo laa napala Perao banya anda kapu kyuo peya.
Isipi range wambu dupwa ipwa epenge dokona kapa narami ingya nayasa ipwa marenge dokona apu rapala ipwa siyamo doko neyami.
Kamongome ipwa piyamo dokopa yuu gii yanda ipingi nembo ipwa doko ranjama ingiya.
